newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were steady to weaker in after-hours trade on Wednesday as sporadic selling by private investors emerged after prices firmed during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.6 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark February was flat at 138.9 yen.

During the day, the yen's weakness against the dollar stimulated short-covering. Volume during the day was 6,555 lots. "Sentiment has improved slightly, backed by the currency market. We are watching whether the dollar will pierce 110 yen soon," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
